name: Shidou Maki
source:
Grade: Second Year
Affiliation: Fighting Maid Club
Attributes: Nursing maid, childhood friend
Problems: Her breasts constantly lactate.
Erogenous Zone(s): Clitoris, nape of the neck, ears, tail
She serves as a maid in the Academy's maid café, "Happy Full Moon St. VERSUS Academy shop", which doubles as a fight club.

That is a secret that only she and Shunosuke know about.
